author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv + Bi-Window mean/LSE cw-mix + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=42
abstract: Bi-window pooling splits the DSConv features into equal halves and computes mean and LSE(τ=0.25, len-norm) per half with channel-wise learned soft mix over [mean1,lse1,mean2,lse2]. Fused with BiGRU via scalar gate. Universal across datasets; aims to improve CRI-Off while keeping APA/MRL strong.
